method: Complete character drawings, never separated leg parts. Keys ordered contact-left, passing-right, contact-right, passing-left; four additional painted in-betweens.

prompts.frontGPTPrompt: Draw a FOUR-frame walk cycle of the white dragon girl in image1, using the BLUE character sheet in image2 as an exact full-body WALK POSE and camera reference. Output TWO columns TWO rows of only WHITE dragon girl. Copy image2's four leg/foot positions and clearly alternating raised knee from top right to bottom right: upper right knee is on screenLEFT, bottom right knee on screenRIGHT. At top left one foot reaches forward, bottom left the OTHER foot reaches forward. Keep the white girl's head, horns, white lavender hair, wings, long tail, ornate white lavender skirt, white shoes, no book. Front three-quarter view slightly facing left so both legs and alternating foot placement are clearly visible. SAME white character in every frame, same camera and scale, same baseline. Whole character drawings with anatomically integrated legs, short chibi legs, no segmented parts, no rig. Natural skirt motion exposes both knees/feet enough to see which is leading. No repeated same-leg swing. Transparent background with equal square cells and generous gutters; no text, no scenery.
prompts.frontBluePrompt: Design FOUR full-body sequential WALK CYCLE KEYFRAMES of this exact blue whale maid chibi, laid out TWO columns TWO rows on transparent background. Keep identity, all clothing/colors, hair/tail, proportions. Camera is a FRONT THREE-QUARTER view, turned only slightly toward LEFT, so BOTH LEGS are separately visible on the left and right side of her hips. Do not use a side view. FOUR DIFFERENT poses: top left LEFT FOOT stepped forward and right foot behind, top right LEFT FOOT supporting body straight down while RIGHT KNEE lifted and crossing forward; bottom left RIGHT FOOT stepped forward with heel planted, LEFT FOOT back with heel lifted, bottom right RIGHT FOOT supporting straight down while LEFT KNEE is lifted and crossing forward. These are opposed limbs, not the same knee in each image! Left leg must stay attached to left hip, right leg to right hip throughout. The forward shoe points somewhat toward viewer and left and looks larger; the rear shoe points left and is partly on its toe. In bottom row swap which shoe is forward/bigger. Arms alternate opposite to legs, skirt sways, feet and short legs clearly visible. Animate a normal two-step walk with intact anatomy, draw complete new full characters, NO separate parts, NO labels. Same face direction and scale in all4 frames, uniform square cells with 12% padding. High quality anime drawing as original.
prompts.contactFixPrompt: Edit ONLY the BOTTOM LEFT cell in this 2x2 animation sheet. The other three cells must remain unchanged. In BOTTOM LEFT, swap which foot is forward: the character's shoe on the viewer's RIGHT must now be the BIG prominent forward shoe at bottom right, connected to the thigh on viewer's right; the shoe on viewer's LEFT must be SMALL and behind at upper left, heel lifted, connected to left thigh. Her forward leg slopes from right hip down-right, rear leg from left hip down-left. This is opposite to the TOP LEFT cell whose large forward shoe is bottom left. Do NOT repeat that top-left leading leg. Retain the rest of the complete character, style, face, hair, tail, wings, dress. Adjust bottom-left skirt naturally for the changed stride. Preserve 2x2 layout and alpha transparency. No detached limbs, no rig, no labels.
prompts.blueContactFixPrompt: Edit ONLY the BOTTOM LEFT cell in this 2x2 animation sheet. The other three cells remain unchanged. In BOTTOM LEFT, swap which foot is forward: the shoe on viewer's RIGHT must now be the BIG prominent forward navy shoe at bottom RIGHT, connected to the thigh on viewer's right, extended down-right. The shoe on viewer's LEFT must be SMALL and BEHIND at upper left, heel lifted, connected to left thigh. This is the OPPOSITE of top-left cell whose large forward shoe is bottom left. Her forward leg slopes right hip downRIGHT, rear leg left hip downLEFT. Draw visible two bent natural SHORT chibi legs wearing original white stockings (not bare long legs). Preserve exact 2x2 layout, true transparent background, complete unsegmented character drawings, no labels or rigs.
prompts.betweenGPTPrompt: Draw FOUR NEW in-between animation cels for this approved 2x2 walking cycle. Same exact white dragon character/camera/proportions/colors/clothes/face, transparent 2x2 sheet, complete bodies and equal padding. The reference poses in reading order are key A left-on-screen shoe forward, B right-on-screen knee raised, C right-on-screen shoe forward, D left-on-screen knee raised. Output topLEFT pose halfway A→B (left foot planted, right foot beginning to lift), topRIGHT halfway B→C (right knee lowering and right shoe reaching down-forward), bottomLEFT halfway C→D (right foot planted, left foot beginning to lift), bottomRIGHT halfway D→A (left knee lowering and left shoe reaching down-forward). Four genuinely different intermediate drawings, NOT copies of the keys. Feet must change support: first two cels lead with RIGHT side leg, last two with LEFT side leg. Keep short legs, small natural steps, subtle skirt sway. Do not change body size between cells. No labels, no separate limbs, no scenery, no outlines around cells, true alpha.
